label: Teltonika TRB143
description: A gigabit 4G gateway with M-Bus: one 10/100/1000 Ethernet port, a Micro-USB and M-Bus support for reading utility meters. The one Teltonika gateway with a gigabit port and a meter bus.
notes: Vendor figures from the TRB143 datasheet: 1 x ETH port 10/100/1000 Mbps (IEEE 802.3); M-Bus support; Micro-USB; 4G LTE Cat 4. No Wi-Fi. M-Bus is a metering bus, not an Ethernet interface, so it is described here rather than modelled as a port.
